why: Both analyses prescribe a focused home-lending hedgehog, flag the brokerage/real-estate diversification and size-driven acquisitions as stop-doing items, and name the rate squeeze, risk-chasing peers and the legacy fixed-rate book. Analysis 2 is preferred because it rates single-state real-estate concentration and a regional bust leading to forced sale as high-severity decline risks (closer to what happened), is slightly more cautious in its gate verdicts, and gives a tighter verdict that opens with the drift toward the wrong fork.
